criteria.criterion: adf.markdown_to_adf emits Markdown-aware ADF nodes (heading/list/code plus inline marks) rather than literal `#`/`-`/`**`; verified by test_cloud_adf_roundtrip asserting node types.
adf.adf_to_markdown returns the source Markdown for a structured body; verified by test_cloud_adf_roundtrip asserting decoded equality.
The combined strong+strikethrough 2-cycle is eliminated by the mark-order canonicalizer; verified by test_cloud_mark_order_converges pinning the measured oscillation as a regression.
An HTML comment present in the source survives the round-trip, falling back to the plain encode when the engine would drop it; verified by test_cloud_html_comment_survives.
adf.fit_markdown_to_adf_limit measures the markdown_to_adf serialization rather than the plain encode; verified by test_adf_fit_measures_the_serialized_document_not_the_plain_text.

With marklas absent, importing adf succeeds and each of the three functions returns its plain-adf.py result rather than raising; verified by test_cloud_functions_degrade_without_marklas simulating the ImportError.
The plain-text fallback helper returns the existing plain adf.py functions as a set; verified by test_cloud_plain_fallback_helper_returns_plain_functions.
Over the committed tests/fixtures/cloud_adf_corpus/, the MD→ADF→MD round-trip reaches a fixed point after one pass for ≥99.6% of bodies; verified by test_cloud_corpus_idempotence.
Over the same fixture, ≥15% of bodies encode to structurally rich ADF under the block-node predicate; verified by test_cloud_corpus_richness.
The committed fixture cardinality is pinned at 360 bodies, so a silent regeneration fails; verified by test_cloud_corpus_cardinality_is_pinned.
The committed fixture carries no unscrubbed emails, tenant hostnames or URLs; verified by test_cloud_corpus_carries_no_unscrubbed_secrets.
AdfCodec and its four ops remain a plain pass-through; verified by the existing test_adf_codec_is_a_pass_through_to_the_pinned_adf_module staying green unmodified.
